more.def: To cause a living thing to die.
examples: A very hard freeze can kill the tomato plants in the garden.
Some medicines kill the germs that make us sick.
Lack of rain killed many trees during the drought.
It is kind to help a friend.
The kind nurse gave me a sticker.

more.def: Friendly, gentle, and caring about how others feel.
examples: A kind stranger helped us find our lost dog.
It was kind of you to share your umbrella.
Her kind words made me feel better.

easy.def: A land with a king or queen.
examples: The queen ruled a big kingdom.
The kingdom had a tall castle.
A dragon lived in the kingdom.

more.def: A country that is ruled by a king or queen.
examples: Everyone in the kingdom came to the castle for the feast.
The news spread across the whole kingdom.
The young prince would one day rule the kingdom.
